source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Yes, I'm happy with that logic.

Right now, after 12 mints, the leader board displays 11 tickets and 11 commissions. Perfect.

However!

The attributes for the NFT still aren't quite right.

My screenshots show the following:

On the leaderboard, NFT #5 displays 2 tickets and 2 x $5 commissions, which is perfect.

After I click NFT #5, the top of the page shows 2 tickets & 2 referrals, also perfect.

However, its attributes still display 1 referral and total earnings of only $5.

value_updates.allocation_finalization: After processRandomReferral(requestId) executes, the randomly selected NFT token ID is credited with one Small Block ticket.

decisions.reason: The candidate already requires calling processRandomReferral(requestId) after VRF fulfillment; acceptance of the resulting commission allocation does not change that ingestion behavior.
The FAQ already states that no-referral commissions and Small Block tickets go to a random existing NFT holder; the backend finalization detail does not require user-facing copy changes.

The accounting Requirement already requires randomly allocated commissions to be registered and reflected consistently; the accepted allocation-finalization mechanism does not alter those accuracy rules.

The metadata Requirement already requires randomly credited commissions and tickets to appear in NFT attributes, and message 688's observed attribute mismatch is already represented as a runtime failure rather than a new value change.
The internal processRandomReferral finalization detail does not change the existing landing-page mechanics copy.

The candidate already requires random no-referral tickets to be registered and associated with the recipient NFT, while the precise finalization mechanism is owned by the no-referral ticket-allocation Requirement.
This candidate governs commissions from valid code-used mints, whereas the source Event changes finalization of randomly allocated no-referral commissions.
The accepted backend finalization mechanism does not require a change to the About-page content at this time.
Prize-draw winner selection is distinct from VRF-assisted selection of a no-referral commission recipient, so the source decision does not change the candidate's draw-selection rules.
Crediting a randomly selected token ID after no-referral processing does not change how an NFT's permanent referral code is defined or displayed.
The source decision concerns post-mint random allocation and does not change which referral codes are valid or the validation feedback messages.
